sn55.39:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme || || 2.
sn55.39:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Kāḷigodhāya sākiyāniyā nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi || || 3.
sn55.39:1.3: Atha kho Kāḷigodhā sākiyānī yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Kāligodham sākiyānim etad avoca || ||
sn55.39:2.1: Catuhi kho Godhe dhammehi samannāgatā ariyasāvikā sotapannā hoti avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā || ||
sn55.39:2.3: Idha Godhe ariyasāvikā Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā hoti ||
sn55.39:2.4: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavāti ||
sn55.39:2.7: Vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāram ajjhāvasati muttacāgā payatapāṇī vossaggaratā yācayogā dānasaṃvibhāgaratā || ||
sn55.39:2.8: Imehi kho Godhe catuhi dhammehi samannāgatā ariyasāvikā sotāpannā hoti avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā ti || || 5.
sn55.39:3.1: Yānimāni bhante Bhagavatā cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni desitāni saṃvijjante te dhammā mayi ahañca tesu dhammesu sandissāmi ||
sn55.39:3.2: ahaṃ hi bhante Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā ||
sn55.39:3.3: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti || ||
sn55.39:3.6: Yaṃ kho pana kiñci kule deyyadhammaṃ sabbaṃ tam appaṭivibhattaṃ sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehī ti || || 6.
sn55.39:3.7: Lābhā te Godhe suladdhan te Godhe
